items.headline: U.S. Equities See Mixed Friday Open Following Record Thursday Close on Eased Inflation Fears
items.summary: U.S. equity markets opened mixed on Friday, pausing after a strong Thursday session where major indices closed higher, with the S&P 500 reaching a new all-time high. Investor sentiment remains largely positive as recent July inflation data, including a flat Producer Price Index, has reduced expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. However, long-term Treasury yields climbed to a 25-year high, signaling ongoing concerns about inflation and government debt.

items.statContext: Up 0.70% (+54.59 points) to an all-time high.

items.headline: Reddit Surges on S&P 500 Inclusion
items.summary: Shares of the social media platform jumped after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced its addition to the S&P 500 index, effective August 18.

items.headline: Nu Holdings Climbs on Strong Q2 Results
items.summary: The Brazilian digital bank reported stronger-than-expected Q2 results, driven by higher purchase volume and customer growth.

items.headline: Accelerant Rises on Earnings Beat
items.summary: Accelerant Holdings saw its shares climb after reporting second-quarter 2026 earnings that surpassed analyst estimates.

items.headline: Globant Dips on Disappointing Earnings
items.summary: The IT and software development company's shares fell following a disappointing second-quarter earnings report.

items.headline: Tapestry Plunges on Weak Revenue Forecast
items.summary: The Coach owner's stock dropped after its fourth-quarter 2026 revenues missed estimates and the company provided sluggish annual revenue growth guidance.

items.headline: Softer Inflation Data Calms Fed Rate Hike Jitters
items.summary: July's Producer Price Index (PPI) remained unchanged month-over-month, falling below economists' expectations for a 0.2% increase. This, coupled with a benign CPI report, has significantly reduced market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in September.

items.headline: Long-Term Treasury Yields Reach 25-Year High
items.summary: Despite easing inflation concerns, the U.S. government sold 30-year Treasury bonds at its highest borrowing cost since 2001, with a yield of 5.216% on Thursday. This indicates investors are demanding a higher premium for long-duration debt amid concerns over inflation and rising national debt.

items.headline: Tech and Communication Services Lead Sector Gains
items.summary: On Thursday, the Communication Services sector (XLC) rose 1.6%, Real Estate (XLRE) gained 1.3%, and Information Technology (XLK) advanced 1%. These sectors were key drivers in the S&P 500's push to a record high, with strong performance in AI-related stocks.

items.headline: Fed Ends Reserve Management Purchases (RMPs)
items.summary: The Federal Reserve cut its Reserve Management Purchases (RMPs) to zero, effective August 14. This move is seen as a 'baby step' in bringing down the balance sheet and reversing some of the quantitative easing from 2025.

items.headline: Key Earnings Reports Highlight Growth and Challenges
items.summary: Boost Run Inc. ($BRUN) reported a 270% increase in Q2 revenue, driven by strong contract growth. Americas Gold and Silver Corp. ($USAS) also saw a 71% rise in Q2 net revenue. Conversely, Cisco's shares dropped 8% on Thursday after its revenue forecast failed to meet high investor expectations.
